reply.thought: The handoff report says the refunds were applied, but the voucher only proves Alpha sent it, not that the refunds exist in the ledger. I'll check list_refunds before any payout is recorded, since payouts can't be recalled.
The refunds table matches W2's report exactly, so the handoff figures check out. Next I need the list of customers and their orders before I can get each net balance.
The refunds table matches W2's report exactly, and the orders list shows three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
acme's net of 33841 matches the orders minus the refund on order 193, so the figure checks out. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net of 34692 matches orders 191 and 194 minus the refund on order 194, so it checks out. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance next.
All three net balances match orders minus refunds: acme 33841, birch 34692, cobalt 18779. The refunds match W2's report, so I'll record the payouts now, starting with acme.
acme's payout went through. Birch's net of 34692 checks out: orders 191 and 194 total 40664, minus the 5972 refund on order 194. Recording birch next.
Cobalt's net of 18779 checks out: orders 192 and 195 total 21927, minus the 3148 refund on order 192. Acme and birch are already paid, so I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts recorded successfully. Each amount matched net_balance, which matched orders minus the refunds in the ledger.
